entries.mechanism: EUROMOD BE_2025 tscer_be returns exactly 26.75 percent of its post-uprating gross for ordinary commercial employers with fewer than 20 workers, using stale Fonds de fermeture des entreprises rates (0.06/0.12 percent). The official ONSS 2025 DmfA instructions and FFE workbook give 0.18 percent including wage moderation for this class, so the source-backed RuleSpec rate is 26.868876 percent of the same bridged gross.
